question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Validate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Confirm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"validate"** means to check or prove the validity or accuracy of something. (सत्यापित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The software was validated by the team to ensure it met all the necessary requirements.
 
 
 
• **"Confirm"** refers to establishing the truth or correctness of something. (पुष्टि करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The scientist confirmed the results of the experiment with additional tests.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Confirm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Collision** (टक्कर): An instance of one moving object or person striking violently against another.

 
 
• **Example:** The collision between the two cars caused a huge traffic jam.
 
 
 
• **Corrupt** (भ्रष्ट): Having or showing a willingness to act dishonestly in return for money or personal gain.
 
 
• **Example:** The official was found to be corrupt and was subsequently removed from office.
 
 
 
• **Conjoin** (मिलाना): Join; combine.
 
 
• **Example:** The two companies decided to conjoin their resources for a larger project.
